info.title: AI Platform API
info.description: Core API for the AI Platform. Provides health verification, auth verification, and OpenAPI contracts.

get.description: Top-level health endpoint verifying service liveness.
Check the operational status, version, and uptime of the API service.
Retrieve the current verified Clerk user profile, MongoDB sync state, and assigned role.

put.description: Update the authorization role of a user ('admin' or 'user'). Requires admin role.

409.description: Explicit slug conflict or unresolvable collision

404.description: Project not found or caller not a member

patch.description: Partial update of project configuration and settings with Optimistic Concurrency Control (version checking).

409.description: OCC version conflict or FSM state mutation prohibition

delete.description: Transition project to SOFT_DELETED with retention grace period (FSM T-04, T-05). Restricted to OWNER.

post.description: Transition project from ACTIVE to ARCHIVED frozen read-only state (FSM T-02).
Transition project from ARCHIVED to ACTIVE operational state (FSM T-03).
Restore soft-deleted project within retention grace period (FSM T-06). Restricted to OWNER.

404.description: Project not found or retention period expired

delete.description: Terminal purge of soft-deleted project (FSM T-07). Cascades cleanup across child collections. Restricted to OWNER.

post.description: Atomic ownership transfer to an active member executed inside a MongoDB transaction (FR-07). Restricted to OWNER.

404.description: Project or target member not found

get.description: List members registered in project with pagination. Accessible to all members (VIEWER+).

404.description: Project not found or caller not a member

post.description: Add an existing user into the project with an assigned role. Restricted to OWNER or ADMIN.

409.description: User already a member or project archived

patch.description: Modify assigned role of an existing project member. Enforces admin hierarchy boundary.

403.description: Admin hierarchy violation or altering owner

delete.description: Remove a member from project or allow member to voluntarily leave. Enforces sole owner invariant and admin hierarchy.

403.description: Sole owner leaving or admin hierarchy violation

409.description: Project archived and caller not self-leaving

get.description: Retrieve immutable security and state mutation event trail. Restricted to OWNER or ADMIN.

404.description: Project not found or caller not a member

post.description: Create and envelope-encrypt a new project secret. Returns metadata only; zero plaintext is returned.

post.description: Batch resolve decrypted plaintext secrets for runtime sandboxes and workflow execution nodes.

get.description: Retrieve metadata for a single project secret. Zero plaintext or ciphertext is returned.

put.description: In-place update of secret metadata or value with Optimistic Concurrency Control revision verification.

409.description: OCC revision mismatch or project archived

delete.description: Soft delete a secret. Immediately excludes it from listings and runtime resolution.

post.description: Privileged plaintext reveal for project administrators (OWNER, ADMIN). Decrypts in-memory, emits immutable audit log, and sets non-cacheable headers.

403.description: Forbidden (VIEWER and MEMBER cannot reveal secret plaintext)

post.description: In-place rotation of secret value with fresh DEK/nonce generation and OCC revision check.

409.description: OCC revision mismatch or project archived

post.description: Generate a new project API credential. Returns plaintext raw_key strictly once. Zero plaintext is stored in the database.

400.description: Validation error, empty scopes, or invalid expiration

409.description: Credential with name already exists in project, or project is archived

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of credential metadata for a project. Raw keys are never returned.

404.description: Project not found or caller not a member

get.description: Retrieve metadata for a single project credential. Raw keys are never returned.

delete.description: Soft-delete (default) or permanently purge (purge=true) a project credential.

post.description: Immediately revoke an active credential. Subsequent API requests using this key will be rejected.
